description: The baseline store of Proof-of-Done in observe mode (plan task pod-25, docs/PROOF-BASELINE.md): the rows a snapshot hands over (lib/proof/tree-snapshot.mjs), the workspace key and the id, the manifest and its refusals, the change list, the workspace lock and its stale rules, the private store (fast-import, alternates, the patch flags, the reproduction check), the record's hash, anchor and fields, the store check against forged objects, retention and leftovers, the acceptance file, the scripts, HEAD and the dirty summary (lib/proof/baseline.mjs), judged by tests/verify-proof-baseline.mjs.

mutations.name: PB-entries-never
mutations.what: the snapshot never hands over its rows

mutations.name: PB-entries-unbounded
mutations.what: an unbounded snapshot hands over the rows of the snapshot before it

mutations.name: PB-entries-raw
mutations.what: raw-v1 does not record its rows

patches.old:
this.lastEntries = pass.files;
    const result = this.describe(plan, { treeAlgorithm: TREE_ALGORITHM.raw, tree: pass.tree, rawTree: pass.tree, full, reason, pass });
patches.new: const result = this.describe(plan, { treeAlgorithm: TREE_ALGORITHM.raw, tree: pass.tree, rawTree: pass.tree, full, reason, pass });
